jobs.description:
As a Data Manager within Global Manufacturing and Supply (GMS) you will be the key person to build and manage the processes, governance and system landscape for our data. In other words, you shape the vision of our future data management set up and will be the driver of the data journey within GMS.
 In our view, good data needs to enable correct and on time supplies to patients and create positive business impact. You will be accountable that all key data of respective systems (e.g. ERP, APS) are created timely, are correct, maintained, synchronized among systems, and communicated to internal and external stakeholders at a high standard and that data quality is reported regularly to stakeholders.
 You will also partner with functions outside GMS and participate in projects that aim to enhance Sobi’s data management environment.
 This position is based at our Global Headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden or Global hub in Basel, Switzerland, reporting directly to Head Global Manufacturing & Supply Excellence.
 Key Responsibilities

• Define, implement, and further develop cross-functional processes and RACI (incl. governance) to create and update Master Data.

• Manage the identification, collection, consolidation and cleansing of master data from various sources.

• Create and update data points and ensure that data sharing among systems works uninterrupted.

• Ensure accurate and timely communication of master data to e.g. 3PL partners and/or Sobi affiliates.

• Define and map source system and user systems of each data point.

• Develop and coordinate / implement data integration strategies to ensure data consistency across systems.

• Collaborate well with various stakeholders within and outside GMS to define and implement ways of working.

• Develop and implement concepts to regularly report data quality, data sharing, and next improvement steps.

• Proactively initiate and potentially lead improvements on processes, systems and roles & responsibilities to enhance data management within GMS, TechOps and Sobi. E.g. Collaborate with IT and software teams to design and implement data solutions including data models, data structures and data interfaces.

• Visualize data points, working processes and systems to business impact (Sobi-TechOps-GMS strategy/value creation plan) and explain / train stakeholders on a) the importance of accurate and timely data management and b) how to collaborate in an efficient and effective way to forester a data-driven culture.

• Be accountable for data related chang controls, respective SOP updates and training / guiding documentation as applicable and set an efficient governance for updating documentation.

• Define a framework for self-inspection on data accuracy to ensure continuous data quality improvement.

About you
 You are a collaborative, patient-focused professional who thrives in a global, multicultural environment. You enjoy connecting the dots between functions, translating complexity of data into clear direction, and building alignment among diverse stakeholders. You model Sobi’s values through your positive mindset, flexibility, and willingness to go the extra mile to support our mission.
 Your experience in similar roles allows you to navigate complexity with confidence and deliver results that help ensure continued access to treatments for rare disease communities.
 Key Qualifications

• 5 – 10 years of experience in data management, Information Technology, and supply chain functions.

• Minimum 5 years’ GMP/GDP experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry.

• Experience working effectively in intercultural and highly matrixed environments.

• Proven ability to build, influence and embed data strategies / process re-designs across cross-functional and remote teams.

• University degree in Data Analytics, Computer science, Information systems, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.

• Strong presentation and communication skills.

• Excellent written and verbal English.

• Strong proficiency in MS Office, ERP systems, Advanced Planning Systems (APS) and Data Management Tools.
 Nice to Have

• Experience in Data analytics and system implementation

• Project management qualification

• Lean Six Sigma qualification / experience

• Knowledge on IFS and Kinaxis Maestro

• AI experience

• Additional langue skills such as Swedish or German
 Here at Sobi we live by our core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership!

How to apply
 We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume.
 Why Join Us?
 Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day, but here are a few more reasons to join our team:

• Collaborative and team-oriented environment

• Opportunities for professional growth

• Diversity and Inclusion

• Competitive compensation for your work

• Making a positive impact to help ultra-rare disease patients who are in need of life saving treatments

• Emphasis on work/life balance

Sobi is a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. We are a specialised international biopharmaceutical company transforming the lives of people with rare and debilitating diseases, providing reliable access to innovative medicines in the areas of haematology, immunology, and specialty care. Sobi’s share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. More about Sobi at sobi.com and LinkedIn.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In qualità di Data Manager all'interno di Global Manufacturing and Supply (GMS), sarai la persona chiave per costruire e gestire i processi, la governance e il panorama del sistema per i nostri dati. In altre parole, darai forma alla visione della nostra futura configurazione di gestione dei dati e sarai il motore del viaggio dei dati all'interno di GMS. A nostro avviso, dati validi devono consentire forniture corrette e puntuali ai pazienti e creare un impatto aziendale positivo. Sarai responsabile del fatto che tutti i dati chiave dei rispettivi sistemi (ad esempio ERP, APS) siano creati tempestivamente, siano corretti, mantenuti, sincronizzati tra i sistemi e comunicati alle parti interessate interne ed esterne secondo uno standard elevato e che la qualità dei dati venga segnalata regolarmente alle parti interessate. Collaborerai anche con funzioni esterne a GMS e parteciperai a progetti che mirano a migliorare l'ambiente di gestione dei dati di Sobi. Questa posizione ha sede presso la nostra sede centrale globale a Stoccolma, Svezia o nell'hub globale a Basilea, Svizzera, riportando direttamente al responsabile Global Manufacturing & Supply Excellence. Responsabilità chiave
• Definire, implementare e sviluppare ulteriormente processi interfunzionali e RACI (inclusa la governance) per creare e aggiornare i dati master.
• Gestire l'identificazione, la raccolta, il consolidamento e la pulizia dei dati anagrafici provenienti da varie fonti.
• Creare e aggiornare i punti dati e garantire che la condivisione dei dati tra i sistemi funzioni senza interruzioni.
• Garantire una comunicazione accurata e tempestiva dei dati anagrafici ad es. Partner 3PL e/o affiliati Sobi.
• Definire e mappare il sistema di origine e i sistemi utente di ciascun punto dati.
• Sviluppare e coordinare/implementare strategie di integrazione dei dati per garantire la coerenza dei dati tra i sistemi.
• Collaborare bene con le varie parti interessate all'interno e all'esterno del GMS per definire e implementare modalità di lavoro.
• Sviluppare e implementare concetti per segnalare regolarmente la qualità dei dati, la condivisione dei dati e le successive fasi di miglioramento.
• Avviare in modo proattivo e potenzialmente guidare miglioramenti su processi, sistemi, ruoli e responsabilità per migliorare la gestione dei dati all'interno di GMS, TechOps e Sobi. Per esempio. Collaborare con team IT e software per progettare e implementare soluzioni dati inclusi modelli di dati, strutture di dati e interfacce di dati.
• Visualizzare punti dati, processi di lavoro e sistemi per l'impatto aziendale (strategia Sobi-TechOps-GMS/piano di creazione di valore) e spiegare/formare le parti interessate su a) l'importanza di una gestione dei dati accurata e tempestiva e b) come collaborare in modo efficiente ed efficace per promuovere una cultura basata sui dati.
• Essere responsabile dei controlli sulle modifiche relative ai dati, dei rispettivi aggiornamenti delle SOP e della documentazione di formazione/guida, ove applicabile, e impostare una governance efficiente per l'aggiornamento della documentazione.
• Definire un quadro per l'autoispezione sull'accuratezza dei dati per garantire il miglioramento continuo della qualità dei dati. Informazioni su di te Sei un professionista collaborativo e concentrato sul paziente che prospera in un ambiente globale e multiculturale. Ti piace collegare i punti tra le funzioni, tradurre la complessità dei dati in una direzione chiara e costruire l'allineamento tra le diverse parti interessate. Modelli i valori di Sobi attraverso la tua mentalità positiva, flessibilità e volontà di fare il possibile per sostenere la nostra missione. La tua esperienza in ruoli simili ti consente di affrontare la complessità con sicurezza e di fornire risultati che aiutano a garantire l'accesso continuo ai trattamenti per le comunità di malattie rare. Qualifiche chiave
• 5 – 10 anni di esperienza nella gestione dei dati, nella tecnologia dell'informazione e nelle funzioni della catena di fornitura.
• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza GMP/GDP nel settore farmaceutico o biotecnologico.
• Esperienza di lavoro efficace in ambienti interculturali e altamente matriciali.
• Comprovata capacità di creare, influenzare e incorporare strategie di dati/riprogettazioni di processi tra team interfunzionali e remoti.
• Laurea universitaria in analisi dei dati, informatica, sistemi informativi, gestione della catena di fornitura o un campo correlato.
• Forti capacità di presentazione e comunicazione.
• Eccellente inglese scritto e orale.
• Ottima conoscenza di MS Office, sistemi ERP, sistemi di pianificazione avanzata (APS) e strumenti di gestione dei dati. Bello da avere
• Esperienza nell'analisi dei dati e nell'implementazione di sistemi
• Qualifica nella gestione di progetti
• Qualifica/esperienza Lean Six Sigma
• Conoscenza di IFS e Kinaxis Maestro
• Esperienza di intelligenza artificiale
• Competenze linguistiche aggiuntive come svedese o tedesco Qui a Sobi viviamo secondo i nostri valori fondamentali: cura, ambizione, urgenza, proprietà e partnership! Come candidarsi Abbiamo un processo di selezione in corso per questo reclutamento e ti chiediamo di inviare la tua candidatura il prima possibile. Fai clic su Applica e includi il tuo curriculum. Perché unirsi a noi? Qui a Sobi, la nostra missione e cultura ci rendono entusiasti di venire al lavoro ogni giorno, ma ecco alcuni motivi in più per entrare a far parte del nostro team:
• Ambiente collaborativo e orientato al team
• Opportunità di crescita professionale
• Diversità e inclusione
• Compensi competitivi per il vostro lavoro
• Avere un impatto positivo per aiutare i pazienti affetti da malattie ultra rare che necessitano di trattamenti salvavita
• Enfasi sull'equilibrio tra lavoro e vita privata Sobi è un'azienda globale con oltre 1.900 dipendenti in più di 30 paesi e si impegna a società in cui operiamo. Siamo un’azienda biofarmaceutica internazionale specializzata che trasforma la vita delle persone affette da malattie rare e debilitanti, fornendo un accesso affidabile a farmaci innovativi nei settori dell’ematologia, dell’immunologia e delle cure specialistiche. Le azioni di Sobi sono quotate al Nasdaq di Stoccolma. Maggiori informazioni su Sobi su sobi.com e LinkedIn. Sappiamo che i nostri dipendenti sono la nostra risorsa più preziosa e la nostra cultura lo trasmette. Offriamo un pacchetto di vantaggi competitivi, per sostenere la salute e la felicità del nostro personale. Cultura Sobi Noi di Sobi ci rifiutiamo di accettare lo status quo. Questo perché siamo stati testimoni in prima persona delle sfide che devono affrontare le persone affette da malattie rare e abbiamo utilizzato questa conoscenza per modellare la nostra attività per trovare nuovi modi per aiutarli. In qualità di azienda biofarmaceutica specializzata, ci dedichiamo alle malattie rare. E vediamo questa attenzione come un punto di forza. Trasformando efficacemente la nostra ricerca in trattamenti innovativi, contribuiamo a rendere la medicina più accessibile e ad aprire più possibilità ai pazienti e più opportunità a coloro che si prendono cura di loro. Questo è stato il nostro approccio fin dal primo giorno, ma sappiamo che non possiamo cambiare il mondo delle malattie rare da soli. Per raggiungere questo obiettivo sono necessarie forti collaborazioni con pazienti, partner e parti interessate lungo l’intera catena del valore. Insieme, definiamo come la nostra azienda può creare soluzioni che soddisfino le esigenze delle persone affette da malattie rare, facilitando al tempo stesso una crescita sostenibile.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Als Datenmanager bei Global Manufacturing and Supply (GMS) sind Sie die Schlüsselperson für den Aufbau und die Verwaltung der Prozesse, Governance und Systemlandschaft für unsere Daten. Mit anderen Worten: Sie prägen die Vision unseres zukünftigen Datenmanagements und sind der Treiber der Datenreise innerhalb von GMS. Unserer Ansicht nach müssen gute Daten eine korrekte und pünktliche Versorgung der Patienten ermöglichen und positive Auswirkungen auf das Geschäft haben. Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, dass alle Schlüsseldaten der jeweiligen Systeme (z. B. ERP, APS) rechtzeitig erstellt, korrekt, gepflegt, zwischen den Systemen synchronisiert und auf hohem Niveau an interne und externe Stakeholder kommuniziert werden und dass die Datenqualität den Stakeholdern regelmäßig gemeldet wird. Sie werden auch mit Funktionen außerhalb von GMS zusammenarbeiten und an Projekten teilnehmen, die darauf abzielen, die Datenverwaltungsumgebung von Sobi zu verbessern. Diese Position ist in unserem globalen Hauptsitz in Stockholm, Schweden, oder unserem globalen Hub in Basel, Schweiz, angesiedelt und berichtet direkt an den Head Global Manufacturing & Supply Excellence. Hauptaufgaben
• Definieren, implementieren und weiterentwickeln Sie funktionsübergreifende Prozesse und RACI (einschließlich Governance), um Stammdaten zu erstellen und zu aktualisieren.
• Verwalten Sie die Identifizierung, Sammlung, Konsolidierung und Bereinigung von Stammdaten aus verschiedenen Quellen.
• Erstellen und aktualisieren Sie Datenpunkte und stellen Sie sicher, dass der Datenaustausch zwischen Systemen unterbrechungsfrei funktioniert.
• Gewährleisten Sie eine genaue und zeitnahe Kommunikation der Stammdaten, z. B. 3PL-Partner und/oder Sobi-Tochtergesellschaften.
• Quellsystem und Benutzersysteme für jeden Datenpunkt definieren und zuordnen.
• Entwickeln und koordinieren/implementieren Sie Datenintegrationsstrategien, um die Datenkonsistenz über Systeme hinweg sicherzustellen.
• Arbeiten Sie gut mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern innerhalb und außerhalb von GMS zusammen, um Arbeitsweisen zu definieren und umzusetzen.
• Entwickeln und implementieren Sie Konzepte zur regelmäßigen Berichterstattung über Datenqualität, Datenaustausch und nächste Verbesserungsschritte.
• Proaktiv Verbesserungen an Prozessen, Systemen sowie Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten initiieren und möglicherweise leiten, um das Datenmanagement innerhalb von GMS, TechOps und Sobi zu verbessern. Z.B. Arbeiten Sie mit IT- und Softwareteams zusammen, um Datenlösungen einschließlich Datenmodellen, Datenstrukturen und Datenschnittstellen zu entwerfen und zu implementieren.
• Visualisieren Sie Datenpunkte, Arbeitsprozesse und Systeme mit geschäftlichen Auswirkungen (Sobi-TechOps-GMS-Strategie/Wertschöpfungsplan) und erläutern/schulen Sie Stakeholder a) über die Bedeutung einer genauen und zeitnahen Datenverwaltung und b) wie man auf effiziente und effektive Weise zusammenarbeitet, um eine datengesteuerte Kultur zu fördern.
• Seien Sie verantwortlich für datenbezogene Änderungskontrollen, entsprechende SOP-Aktualisierungen und Schulungs-/Leitdokumentation, sofern zutreffend, und legen Sie eine effiziente Governance für die Aktualisierung der Dokumentation fest.
• Definieren Sie einen Rahmen für die Selbstprüfung der Datengenauigkeit, um eine kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Datenqualität sicherzustellen. Über Sie: Sie sind ein kooperativer, patientenorientierter Fachmann, der in einem globalen, multikulturellen Umfeld erfolgreich ist. Es macht Ihnen Spaß, die Zusammenhänge zwischen den Funktionen zu verknüpfen, die Komplexität der Daten in eine klare Richtung zu übersetzen und eine Abstimmung zwischen verschiedenen Interessengruppen herzustellen. Sie verkörpern die Werte von Sobi durch Ihre positive Einstellung, Flexibilität und Bereitschaft, die Extrameile zu gehen, um unsere Mission zu unterstützen. Ihre Erfahrung in ähnlichen Rollen ermöglicht es Ihnen, mit der Komplexität sicher umzugehen und Ergebnisse zu liefern, die dazu beitragen, den dauerhaften Zugang zu Behandlungen für Gemeinschaften mit seltenen Krankheiten sicherzustellen. Schlüsselqualifikationen
• 5 – 10 Jahre Erfahrung in Datenmanagement, Informationstechnologie und Lieferkettenfunktionen.
• Mindestens 5 Jahre GMP/GDP-Erfahrung in der Pharma- oder Biotech-Industrie.
• Erfahrung in der effektiven Arbeit in interkulturellen und stark geprägten Umgebungen.
• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Datenstrategien/Prozessneugestaltungen in funktionsübergreifenden und Remote-Teams zu entwickeln, zu beeinflussen und einzubetten.
• Universitätsabschluss in Datenanalyse, Informatik, Informationssystemen, Supply Chain Management oder einem verwandten Bereich.
• Starke Präsentations- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.
• Ausgezeichnetes Englisch in Wort und Schrift.
• Gute Kenntnisse in MS Office, ERP-Systemen, Advanced Planning Systems (APS) und Datenmanagement-Tools. Nice to Have
• Erfahrung in Datenanalyse und Systemimplementierung
• Projektmanagement-Qualifikation
• Lean Six Sigma-Qualifikation/-Erfahrung
• Kenntnisse über IFS und Kinaxis Maestro
• KI-Erfahrung
• Zusätzliche Sprachkenntnisse wie Schwedisch oder Deutsch Hier bei Sobi leben wir nach unseren Grundwerten: Fürsorge, Ehrgeiz, Dringlichkeit, Eigenverantwortung und Partnerschaft! So bewerben Sie sich: Bei dieser Stellenbesetzung führen wir ein fortlaufendes Auswahlverfahren durch und bitten Sie, Ihre Bewerbung so schnell wie möglich abzusenden. Klicken Sie auf „Bewerben“ und fügen Sie Ihren Lebenslauf bei. Warum sollten Sie bei uns mitmachen? Hier bei Sobi freuen wir uns jeden Tag über unsere Mission und Kultur, zur Arbeit zu kommen, aber hier sind noch ein paar weitere Gründe, unserem Team beizutreten:
• Kollaboratives und teamorientiertes Umfeld
• Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen Weiterentwicklung
• Vielfalt und Inklusion
• Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung für Ihre Arbeit
• Einen positiven Einfluss ausüben, um Patienten mit extrem seltenen Krankheiten zu helfen, die lebensrettende Behandlungen benötigen
• Schwerpunkt auf Work-Life-Balance Sobi ist ein globales Unternehmen mit über 1.900 Mitarbeitern in mehr als 30 Ländern und engagieren uns für die Gesellschaften, in denen wir tätig sind. Wir sind ein spezialisiertes internationales biopharmazeutisches Unternehmen, das das Leben von Menschen mit seltenen und belastenden Krankheiten verändert und zuverlässigen Zugang zu innovativen Arzneimitteln in den Bereichen Hämatologie, Immunologie und Spezialversorgung bietet. Die Aktie von Sobi ist an der Nasdaq Stockholm notiert. Mehr über Sobi auf sobi.com und LinkedIn. Wir wissen, dass unsere Mitarbeiter unser wertvollstes Kapital sind, und unsere Kultur vermittelt dies. Wir bieten ein wettbewerbsfähiges Leistungspaket, um die Gesundheit und Zufriedenheit unserer Mitarbeiter zu unterstützen. Sobi-Kultur Bei Sobi weigern wir uns, den Status quo zu akzeptieren. Dies liegt daran, dass wir die Herausforderungen, vor denen die von seltenen Krankheiten Betroffenen stehen, aus erster Hand miterlebt haben und dieses Wissen genutzt haben, um unser Unternehmen so zu gestalten, dass neue Wege gefunden werden, ihnen zu helfen. Als spezialisiertes biopharmazeutisches Unternehmen widmen wir uns seltenen Krankheiten. Und wir sehen diesen Fokus als Stärke. Indem wir unsere Forschung effektiv in bahnbrechende Behandlungen umsetzen, tragen wir dazu bei, die Medizin zugänglicher zu machen und mehr Möglichkeiten für Patienten und mehr Chancen für ihre Betreuer zu eröffnen. Dies ist seit dem ersten Tag unser Ansatz, aber wir wissen, dass wir die Welt der seltenen Krankheiten nicht alleine verändern können. Um dies zu erreichen, sind starke Partnerschaften mit Patienten, Partnern und Interessengruppen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette erforderlich. Gemeinsam definieren wir, wie unser Unternehmen Lösungen schaffen kann, die den Bedürfnissen der von seltenen Krankheiten Betroffenen gerecht werden und gleichzeitig nachhaltiges Wachstum ermöglichen.

En tant que gestionnaire de données au sein de Global Manufacturing and Supply (GMS), vous serez la personne clé pour créer et gérer les processus, la gouvernance et l'environnement système de nos données. En d’autres termes, vous façonnez la vision de notre future gestion des données et serez le moteur du parcours des données au sein de GMS. À notre avis, des données de qualité doivent permettre un approvisionnement correct et ponctuel des patients et créer un impact commercial positif. Vous serez responsable de ce que toutes les données clés des systèmes respectifs (par exemple ERP, APS) soient créées en temps opportun, soient correctes, maintenues, synchronisées entre les systèmes et communiquées aux parties prenantes internes et externes selon des normes élevées et que la qualité des données soit régulièrement signalée aux parties prenantes. Vous travaillerez également en partenariat avec des fonctions extérieures à GMS et participerez à des projets visant à améliorer l’environnement de gestion des données de Sobi. Responsabilités clés
• Définir, mettre en œuvre et développer davantage les processus interfonctionnels et RACI (y compris la gouvernance) pour créer et mettre à jour les données de référence.
• Gérer l'identification, la collecte, la consolidation et le nettoyage des données de base provenant de diverses sources.
• Créez et mettez à jour des points de données et assurez-vous que le partage de données entre les systèmes fonctionne sans interruption.
• Assurer une communication précise et opportune des données de base, par ex. Partenaires 3PL et/ou affiliés Sobi.
• Définir et cartographier le système source et les systèmes utilisateur de chaque point de données.
• Développer et coordonner/mettre en œuvre des stratégies d'intégration de données pour assurer la cohérence des données entre les systèmes.
• Collaborer efficacement avec diverses parties prenantes au sein et à l'extérieur de GMS pour définir et mettre en œuvre des méthodes de travail.
• Développer et mettre en œuvre des concepts pour rendre compte régulièrement de la qualité des données, du partage des données et des prochaines étapes d'amélioration.
• Initier de manière proactive et potentiellement diriger des améliorations sur les processus, les systèmes et les rôles et responsabilités afin d'améliorer la gestion des données au sein de GMS, TechOps et Sobi. Vous aimez relier les points entre les fonctions, traduire la complexité des données en une direction claire et établir un alignement entre les diverses parties prenantes. Votre expérience dans des rôles similaires vous permet de naviguer dans la complexité en toute confiance et d'obtenir des résultats qui contribuent à garantir un accès continu aux traitements pour les communautés de maladies rares. jobs.description:
About the role
 Global Quality plays a key role in making sure our medicines meet internal standards, regulatory expectations, and the commitments in our registration files. As an independent quality organisation, we bring the expertise to deliver on these commitments—while continuously strengthening our capabilities, developing our people, and evolving our quality system to support the business as we grow.
 As QA Analytical Specialist, you’ll be the quality partner for analytical activities and stability studies for products where Sobi is the MAH. You’ll ensure GMP-compliant methods and data support reliable release and stability testing for both clinical and commercial supply—working closely with internal stakeholders and external partners to keep quality, compliance, and patient impact at the centre of everything we do.
 It is a Hybrid role and can be based in either Stockholm or Basel, reporting to Head of Quality Product Lifecycle & Clinical Supply.

Key Responsibilities

• Coordinator and Quality approver for deviations, CAPA and change controls.

• QA-approver for GMP-related analytical activities, e.g. validation and technology transfer of analytical methods used for in-process control, release and stability studies.

• Performance of quality evaluation of CLOs.

• QA contact for CLOs

• Provide Quality Assurance for stability studies for products where Sobi is the MAH, including approving plans and protocols.

• Perform QA review and approval of extension of expiry date of critical analytical material, including but not limited to reference standards and control samples.

• Perform QA review and approval of product specifications.

• Give support to Global Regulatory Affairs / CMC in analytical quality issues for variations and market expansions.

• Act as a representative of Global Quality and provide QA analytical guidance to support projects in order to ensure compliance with GMP

• Manage Quality Technical Agreements with CLOs.

• Author, review and approve SOPs and related documentation related to the position.

About you
 You’re a quality-minded analytical professional who enjoys working cross-functionally, taking ownership, and bringing structure to complex scientific work. You combine strong GMP understanding with a collaborative mindset, and you’re motivated by the opportunity to help deliver reliable, high-quality medicines to patients who need them most.
 Qualifications

• University degree in Chemistry, Biology, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Science, or similar.

• 5+ years’ experience in GMP analytical work within pharma/biotech—covering analytical method development and validation, product specifications, deviation investigations, and change control; ideally in QA supporting QC (or as a QC Coordinator/similar).

• Broad knowledge of analytical chemistry and bioassays, including clear and compliant documentation practices.

• Professional proficiency in English, written and spoken.

• You live the Sobi CARE values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership.

• Ability to work independently, take initiative, and make sound quality decisions.

• Strong communication skills and a collaborative, team-oriented approach.

• A structured mindset with attention to detail and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Here at Sobi we live by our core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership!

How to apply
 We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume.
 Why Join Us?
 Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day, but here are a few more reasons to join our team:

• Collaborative and team-oriented environment

• Opportunities for professional growth

• Diversity and Inclusion

• Competitive compensation for your work

• Making a positive impact to help ultra-rare disease patients who are in need of life saving treatments

• Emphasis on work/life balance

Sobi is a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. We are a specialised international biopharmaceutical company transforming the lives of people with rare and debilitating diseases, providing reliable access to innovative medicines in the areas of haematology, immunology, and specialty care. Sobi’s share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. More about Sobi at sobi.com and LinkedIn.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

Qui a Sobi, la nostra missione e la nostra cultura ci eccitano a lavorare ogni giorno, ma qui ci sono alcune altre ragioni per unirsi al nostro team: - Ambiente collaborativo e di team-oriented - Opportunità per la crescita professionale - Diversità e inclusione - Compenso competitivo per il vostro lavoro - Rendere un impatto positivo per aiutare i pazienti affetti da malattie ultra rare che hanno bisogno di trattamenti di salvataggio - l'enfasi sul lavoro/equilibrio di vita Sobi è una società globale impegnata con oltre 1900 persone. Siamo un'azienda biofarmaceutica internazionale specializzata che trasforma la vita di persone con malattie rare e debilitanti, fornendo un accesso affidabile a farmaci innovativi nelle aree di ematologia, immunologia e cura delle specialità. La quota di Sobi è quotata su Nasdaq Stockholm. Maggiori informazioni su Sobi a sobi.com e LinkedIn. Sappiamo che i nostri dipendenti sono il nostro bene più prezioso e la nostra cultura lo trasmette.
• Offriamo un pacchetto di benefici competitivi, per sostenere la salute e la felicità del nostro personale. Sobi Culture A Sobi, ci rifiutiamo di accettare lo status quo. Questo perché abbiamo assistito in prima persona alle sfide che le persone colpite da malattie rare e abbiamo usato questa conoscenza per plasmare la nostra attività per trovare nuovi modi di aiutarli. Come azienda biofarmaceutica specializzata, siamo dedicati a malattie rare. E vediamo questo obiettivo come una forza. Trasformando efficacemente la nostra ricerca in trattamenti innovativi, aiutiamo a rendere la medicina più accessibile e aprire più possibilità per i pazienti e più opportunità per chi li cura. Questo è stato il nostro approccio dal primo giorno, ma sappiamo che non possiamo cambiare il mondo di malattie rare da soli. Il completamento di questo richiede forti partnership con pazienti, partner e stakeholder in tutta la catena del valore. Insieme, definiamo come il nostro business può creare soluzioni che servono le esigenze di coloro che sono colpiti da malattie rare, facilitando la crescita sostenibile. Manufacturing Science and Technology  (MSAT) is part of the Global CMC, Science & Technology Department (GCSAT).
 GCSAT is responsible for optimization and life cycle management of Sobis clinical and commercial manufacturing processes from internal and external network. MSAT ensures compliant, reliable, cost effective and sustainable manufacturing of our products now and in future. The MSAT team holds the senior scientific and technical knowledge for the manufacturing of Sobis clinical and commercial products and is responsible for always keeping the internal and external manufacturing processes in a validated stage.
 Main responsibilities:

• Process owner of DS validation for Sobi products.

• Lead and execute MSAT projects such as manufacturing process and cost improvement as part of LCM.

• Participate in internal activities related to (external) manufacturing such as process changes, major/critical deviations, risk assessments and CAPAs.

• Issue, review and approve applicable internal and external SOP’s and manufacturing instructions.

• Review and supervise set up, execution and documentation of technical studies, qualifications and validations.

• Write and review applicable sections of the APR/PQR.

• Write and review applicable sections in registration files, variations and market expansion.

• Support in sourcing evaluation of new DS contract manufacturers and participation in developing supply and quality agreements.

• Lead the technical part of a product transfer, scale up activities, validations and oversees manufacturing of DS processes at external manufacturers for Sobi projects in clinical and commercial phase.

• Be aware of external biopharmaceutical manufacturing technology advancements, understand and introduce new technologies and how they may be applicable to process innovation, cost or yield improvement

• University education in Chemistry, Biology, Biotechnology, Pharmacy or similar.

• +5 years of experience of development and manufacturing of Drug Substance for clinical and commercial use

• Scientific and technical background of CMC development and manufacturing of Drug Substance.

• Recognized expert in drug substance manufacturing

• Demonstrable experience of working in cross functional team with ability to multi task, prioritize and be an effective decision maker

• Experience of regulatory guidelines, regulatory authorities communication and file documentation

• Fluent in English

How to apply
 We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume in English.
 Why Join Us?
 Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day, but here are a few more reasons to join our team:

• Emphasis on work/life balance

• Collaborative and team-oriented environment

• Opportunities for professional growth

• Diversity and Inclusion

• Competitive compensation for your work

• Making a positive impact to help ultra-rare disease patients who are in need of life saving treatments
 We are a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

jobs.description:
The IT department, a part of IS/IT, are responsible for architecture, strategy, maintenance and support of Sobi information systems and IT infrastructure as clients, servers, network and other infrastructure equipment.
 The IT department consist of four teams – IT Operations, Infrastructure & Cyber security, Digital Workplace and Automation & Integration.All IT activities are performed in accordance with Sobi’s quality framework (GxP) and applicable regulatory and authority requirements.
 Within this context, the Digital Workplace & AI function plays a key role in enabling secure, compliant, and scalable digital solutions across Sobi. Under the leadership of the Head of Digital Workplace & AI, the team is responsible for developing and advancing Sobi’s Digital Workplace, Microsoft 365 platform, and enterprise AI capabilities. This includes setting strategic direction, defining objectives, and delivering modern, AI-enabled tools that support collaboration, productivity, and innovation across the organization.
 Main responsibilities:

• Develop and maintain enterprise-grade AI applications built on Azure OpenAI, including chat interfaces, document processing pipelines (RAG), and real-time collaboration features

• Design and implement Azure cloud solutions leveraging Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Cognitive Search, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Document Intelligence, and Azure AI Search

• Build and optimize full-stack applications using Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, and modern frontend/backend patterns (App Router, Server Components, Server Actions)

• Optimize AI/LLM integrations, including prompt engineering, token management, streaming completions, and multi-model AI orchestration

• Ensure code quality, security, and compliance through code reviews, testing, documentation, and adherence to Sobi's quality framework (GxP)

• Work proactively with ServiceNow to resolve incoming bug reports and other issues

• 4+ years of professional experience working as a software developer

• React / Next JS / Typescript / Azure Knowledge

• Proven ability to work autonomously and take ownership of features from concept to deployment

• Hands-on experience with Azure cloud services (Cosmos DB, Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Search, Blob Storage)

• Experience building and maintaining full-stack applications in production environment

• AI / LLM / Agent experience

• Fluent in English (written and spoken)
 Ideally you bring also:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)

• Experience in healthcare, pharmaceutical, or regulated industries preferred

How to apply
 We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume in English.
 Why Join Us?
 Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day, but here are a few more reasons to join our team:

• Emphasis on work/life balance

• Collaborative and team-oriented environment

• Opportunities for professional growth

• Diversity and Inclusion

• Competitive compensation for your work

• Making a positive impact to help ultra-rare disease patients who are in need of life saving treatments
 We are a global company with over 1,800 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open up more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

jobs.description:
About the role
 As the Director of Information Security Governance & Compliance, you will play a key leadership role in ensuring that Sobi’s information security framework is robust, effective and fit for a highly regulated environment. You will lead governance and compliance activities across Sobi and our external partners, drive audits and control reviews, maintain a strong and up-to-date ISMS, and oversee CAPA and continuous improvement initiatives. In this role, you will work closely with the CISO, Quality and key stakeholders across the business to make sure our policies, processes and responsibilities are clear, aligned and continuously improving.
 You will join our Global Information Security team, report to the CISO, and be based at our Stockholm HQ or Global Hub in Basel. This is a hybrid role with the opportunity to work in an international setting where your expertise will have visible impact across the organisation.

Your impact will include:

• Lead and evolve Sobi’s information security governance framework and ISMS, including policies, standards and procedures.

• Ensure alignment with key regulatory and industry frameworks such as NIS2, GDPR and ISO 27001.

• Plan and lead internal and external audits, as well as compliance reviews across the organisation and third parties.

• Oversee incident follow-up, root cause analysis, CAPA activities and risk mitigation tracking to closure.

• Establish meaningful compliance and risk metrics, continuous improvement processes and provide clear reporting to support decision-making.

• Partner closely with the CISO, Quality, business stakeholders, auditors and external partners to build a strong culture of accountability and security awareness.

About you
 You are a confident and pragmatic information security leader who enjoys combining governance, compliance and continuous improvement in a way that creates real business value. You are comfortable navigating a complex, regulated environment and know how to translate frameworks and requirements into practical ways of working. Just as importantly, you build trust across functions and communicate with clarity—whether you are partnering with senior stakeholders, supporting audits, or driving follow-up actions with the wider organisation. You bring a structured and proactive mindset, a strong sense of ownership, and a genuine interest in building a security culture that is both effective and sustainable.
 What you bring

• Strong experience in information security governance, risk and compliance, ideally in a global or highly regulated environment.

• Solid knowledge of relevant frameworks and regulations such as NIS2, GDPR, ISO 27001 and ideally GxP/ALCOA+ or GAMP.

• A proven ability to lead audits, compliance programmes and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Experience working with third-party assessments, supplier compliance or external oversight.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to prioritise, follow through and create structure in complex topics.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to influence across functions and levels.

Here at Sobi we live by our core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership!

How to apply
 We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume.
 Why Join Us?
 Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day, but here are a few more reasons to join our team:

• Collaborative and team-oriented environment

• Opportunities for professional growth

• Diversity and Inclusion

• Competitive compensation for your work

• Making a positive impact to help ultra-rare disease patients who are in need of life saving treatments

• Emphasis on work/life balance

Sobi is a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. We are a specialised international biopharmaceutical company transforming the lives of people with rare and debilitating diseases, providing reliable access to innovative medicines in the areas of haematology, immunology, and specialty care. Sobi’s share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. More about Sobi at sobi.com and LinkedIn.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

jobs.description:
About the role
 Are you energized by complexity, motivated by purpose, and excited by the opportunity to shape supply planning for a product in a pivotal growth phase? As Strategic Planning Manager for you will play a central role in ensuring robust product availability across Drug Substance, Drug Product and Finished Goods. Working across the full supply chain, you will translate commercial and medical priorities into clear, executable plans, navigate uncertainty with confidence, and help steer key decisions that directly support patients living with rare diseases.
 This role offers broad visibility and impact, spanning strategic long-term planning, tactical decision-making, and day-to-day supply assurance.
 You will join our Global Supply Operations team, report to the Head of Planning, and be based at our Stockholm HQ or Global Hub in Basel.

In this role, you will:

• Own and continuously evolve the integrated end-to-end supply plan across short-, mid- and long-term horizons, balancing commercial and medical demand, inventory strategy and supply capabilities.

• Lead scenario planning and supply risk assessments, translating uncertainty into clear options, recommendations and decision material for governance and senior stakeholders.

• Turn demand signals into capacity, material and inventory requirements, and drive alignment on assumptions and commitments across key planning cycles.

• Shape allocation and supply prioritization proposals when demand exceeds supply, ensuring transparent trade-offs and strong alignment across markets, indications and programs.

• Partner closely with Commercial, Medical, TechOps, Quality, Regulatory, Global Distribution and external partners to create one aligned, executable plan.

• Prepare and present planning insights, risks and mitigation plans in product teams and governance forums, acting as a trusted voice on supply planning and constraints.

• Establish meaningful planning KPIs and continuously improve ways of working, data quality and tools to strengthen planning performance over time.

About you
 You are someone who thrives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment and brings calm, structure and sound judgement when complexity is high. You enjoy working across functions and geographies, influencing without formal authority, and turning ambiguity into clear direction. Just as importantly, you are motivated by meaningful work and excited by the opportunity to help secure supply for patients who rely on innovative treatment options.

To succeed in this role, you will bring:

• A university degree in engineering, supply chain, business, finance or a related field.

• Significant experience in end-to-end supply planning within pharma, biotech or another highly regulated and complex supply chain environment.

• A strong track record of building integrated demand and supply plans, leading scenario planning, and navigating supply constraints and prioritization decisions.

• Experience working cross-functionally with close exposure to Commercial and/or Medical organizations, ideally in launch, access or demand-shaping environments.

• An advanced degree, MBA, or experience in launch planning, indication expansion, partnership supply chains or capacity expansion projects would be an advantage

• Strong end-to-end planning expertise, including S&OP, supply planning, inventory strategy, capacity planning and scenario management.

• The ability to translate complex data into clear insights, business decisions and practical actions.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with confidence presenting to senior forums and driving alignment under pressure.

• Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with advanced Excel capabilities and experience with planning or analytics systems such as Kinaxis Maestro or Power BI considered a plus.

• Fluent English, both written and spoken; additional languages are an advantage.

Here at Sobi we live by our core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership!

How to apply
 We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume in English.
 Why Join Us?
 Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day, but here are a few more reasons to join our team:

• Collaborative and team-oriented environment

• Opportunities for professional growth

• Diversity and Inclusion

• Competitive compensation for your work

• Making a positive impact to help ultra-rare disease patients who are in need of life saving treatments

• Emphasis on work/life balance

We are a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open up more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

jobs.description:
About the role
 As Senior Manager, Global Strategic Sourcing, you will play an important role in shaping how Sobi builds a resilient, sustainable, and forward-looking supply network. Working across innovation, manufacturing, and commercial functions, you will help connect strategy with execution and influence sourcing decisions that support both our business and the patients we serve globally.
 You will join our Global Strategic Sourcing & Direct Procurement team, report to the VP Global Strategic Sourcing, and this Hybrid role will be based at our Stockholm HQ or Global Hub in Basel.
 In this role, you will:

• Lead the development and execution of global sourcing strategies that enable a resilient, cost-efficient, and sustainable supply network for Sobi’s clinical and commercial manufacturing.

• Combine a strategic and commercial mindset to evaluate and optimize sourcing decisions throughout the product lifecycle — from development to commercialization and life-cycle management.

• Drive cross-functional collaboration across Technical Operations, Legal, Tax, Finance, and other key stakeholders to negotiate and implement complex, high-value global contracts.

• Design and maintain a strategic sourcing roadmap, ensuring alignment with Sobi’s business goals and long-term vision.

• Contribute to due diligence efforts in business development projects, providing critical input on manufacturing and sourcing opportunities.

• Anticipate market trends and assess supplier capabilities to deliver data-driven sourcing recommendations that strengthen Sobi’s competitive edge.

• Lead business cases for Technical Operations projects, from financial approval through to contract execution, and continuously enhance sourcing processes and procurement policies to drive efficiency and innovation.

About you
 You bring a thoughtful mix of strategic perspective and practical execution. You are comfortable working across functions, building trust, and navigating complexity in an international environment. Just as importantly, you are someone who brings curiosity, sound judgment, and a collaborative mindset—someone who enjoys turning ideas into action and creating impact together with others.
 Key Qualifications

• A university degree in Business, Chemistry, Science, Industrial Engineering, or another relevant field.

• Experience from the pharmaceutical or biotech industry, ideally within sourcing, procurement, or outsourced manufacturing.

• Proven success negotiating fact-based complex, high-value global contracts in a multicultural setting.

• Understanding cGMP manufacturing and global regulatory standards.

• Experience in global, matrixed organizations and cross-functional collaboration.
 Skills & Knowledge:

• Excellent communication skills in English (written and spoken).

• Strong financial and analytical acumen (COGS and cost structures).

• Expertise in global sourcing strategies and supplier performance management.

• Exceptional commercial mindset and business judgment.
 Here at Sobi we live by our core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership!

How to apply
 We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume.
 Why Join Us?
 Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day, but here are a few more reasons to join our team:

• Collaborative and team-oriented environment

• Opportunities for professional growth

• Diversity and Inclusion

• Competitive compensation for your work

• Making a positive impact to help ultra-rare disease patients who are in need of life saving treatments

• Emphasis on work/life balance

Sobi is a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. We are a specialised international biopharmaceutical company transforming the lives of people with rare and debilitating diseases, providing reliable access to innovative medicines in the areas of haematology, immunology, and specialty care. Sobi’s share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. More about Sobi at sobi.com and LinkedIn.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

Informazioni su di te Porta un mix ponderato di prospettiva strategica ed esecuzione pratica. Ti senti a tuo agio nel lavorare tra più funzioni, creare fiducia e affrontare la complessità in un ambiente internazionale. Altrettanto importante, sei qualcuno che porta curiosità, buon giudizio e una mentalità collaborativa, qualcuno a cui piace trasformare le idee in azioni e creare impatto insieme agli altri. Qualifiche chiave
• Una laurea in Economia, Chimica, Scienze, Ingegneria Industriale o un altro campo pertinente.
• Esperienza nel settore farmaceutico o biotecnologico, idealmente nell'ambito dell'approvvigionamento, dell'approvvigionamento o della produzione in outsourcing.
• Comprovato successo nella negoziazione di contratti globali complessi e di alto valore basati sui fatti in un contesto multiculturale.
• Comprendere la produzione cGMP e gli standard normativi globali.
• Esperienza in organizzazioni globali a matrice e collaborazione interfunzionale. Competenze e conoscenze:
• Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione in inglese (scritto e parlato).
• Forte acume finanziario e analitico (COGS e strutture dei costi).
• Competenza nelle strategie di approvvigionamento globale e nella gestione delle prestazioni dei fornitori.
• Mentalità commerciale e giudizio aziendale eccezionali. Qui a Sobi viviamo secondo i nostri valori fondamentali: cura, ambizione, urgenza, proprietà e partnership! Come candidarsi Abbiamo un processo di selezione in corso per questo reclutamento e ti chiediamo di inviare la tua candidatura il prima possibile. Fai clic su Applica e includi il tuo curriculum. Perché unirsi a noi? Qui a Sobi, la nostra missione e cultura ci rendono entusiasti di venire al lavoro ogni giorno, ma ecco alcuni altri motivi per entrare a far parte del nostro team:
• Ambiente collaborativo e orientato al team
• Opportunità di crescita professionale
• Diversità e inclusione
• Compensazione competitiva per il tuo lavoro
• Avere un impatto positivo per aiutare i pazienti affetti da malattie ultra rare che necessitano di trattamenti salvavita
• Enfasi sull'equilibrio tra lavoro e vita privata Sobi è un'azienda globale con oltre 1.900 dipendenti in più di 30 paesi e si impegna alle società in cui operiamo. Siamo un’azienda biofarmaceutica internazionale specializzata che trasforma la vita delle persone affette da malattie rare e debilitanti, fornendo un accesso affidabile a farmaci innovativi nei settori dell’ematologia, dell’immunologia e delle cure specialistiche. Le azioni di Sobi sono quotate al Nasdaq di Stoccolma. Maggiori informazioni su Sobi su sobi.com e LinkedIn. Sappiamo che i nostri dipendenti sono la nostra risorsa più preziosa e la nostra cultura lo trasmette. Offriamo un pacchetto di vantaggi competitivi, per sostenere la salute e la felicità del nostro personale. Cultura Sobi Noi di Sobi ci rifiutiamo di accettare lo status quo. Questo perché siamo stati testimoni in prima persona delle sfide che devono affrontare le persone affette da malattie rare e abbiamo utilizzato questa conoscenza per modellare la nostra attività per trovare nuovi modi per aiutarli. In qualità di azienda biofarmaceutica specializzata, ci dedichiamo alle malattie rare. E vediamo questa attenzione come un punto di forza. Trasformando efficacemente la nostra ricerca in trattamenti innovativi, contribuiamo a rendere la medicina più accessibile e ad aprire più possibilità ai pazienti e più opportunità a coloro che si prendono cura di loro. Questo è stato il nostro approccio fin dal primo giorno, ma sappiamo che non possiamo cambiare il mondo delle malattie rare da soli. Per raggiungere questo obiettivo sono necessarie forti collaborazioni con pazienti, partner e parti interessate lungo l’intera catena del valore. Insieme, definiamo come la nostra azienda può creare soluzioni che soddisfino le esigenze delle persone affette da malattie rare, facilitando al tempo stesso una crescita sostenibile.

• Erfahrung in globalen, Matrixorganisationen und funktionsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit. Fähigkeiten und Kenntnisse:
• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch (schriftlich und mündlich).

• Kollaboratives und teamorientiertes Umfeld
• Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen Weiterentwicklung
• Vielfalt und Inklusion
• Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung für Ihre Arbeit
• Einen positiven Einfluss ausüben, um Patienten mit extrem seltenen Krankheiten zu helfen, die lebensrettende Behandlungen benötigen
• Schwerpunkt auf Work-Life-Balance Sobi ist ein globales Unternehmen mit über 1.900 Mitarbeitern in mehr als 30 Länder und engagieren uns für die Gesellschaften, in denen wir tätig sind. Die Aktie von Sobi ist an der Nasdaq Stockholm notiert. Mehr über Sobi auf sobi.com und LinkedIn. Wir wissen, dass unsere Mitarbeiter unser wertvollstes Kapital sind, und unsere Kultur vermittelt dies. Wir bieten ein wettbewerbsfähiges Leistungspaket, um die Gesundheit und Zufriedenheit unserer Mitarbeiter zu unterstützen. Sobi-Kultur Bei Sobi weigern wir uns, den Status quo zu akzeptieren. Dies liegt daran, dass wir die Herausforderungen, vor denen die von seltenen Krankheiten Betroffenen stehen, aus erster Hand miterlebt haben und dieses Wissen genutzt haben, um unser Unternehmen so zu gestalten, dass neue Wege gefunden werden, ihnen zu helfen. Als spezialisiertes biopharmazeutisches Unternehmen widmen wir uns seltenen Krankheiten. Und wir sehen diesen Fokus als Stärke. Indem wir unsere Forschung effektiv in bahnbrechende Behandlungen umsetzen, tragen wir dazu bei, die Medizin zugänglicher zu machen und mehr Möglichkeiten für Patienten und mehr Chancen für ihre Betreuer zu eröffnen. Dies ist seit dem ersten Tag unser Ansatz, aber wir wissen, dass wir die Welt der seltenen Krankheiten nicht alleine verändern können. Um dies zu erreichen, sind starke Partnerschaften mit Patienten, Partnern und Interessengruppen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette erforderlich. Gemeinsam definieren wir, wie unser Unternehmen Lösungen schaffen kann, die den Bedürfnissen der von seltenen Krankheiten Betroffenen gerecht werden und gleichzeitig nachhaltiges Wachstum ermöglichen.

jobs.description:
The European Supply Chain Associate Director leads the supply chain topics, ensuring accurate demand planning, replenishment, and inventory management across European portfolio. They will also oversee business processes with the affiliates. The manager continuously improves the supply chain using digital and data-driven industry 4.0 standards, adding long-term value to the organization. Additionally, they require strong people development skills and a proactive learning approach.
 Key Responsibilities

• Execute cluster/affiliate Demand Planning meetings to align stakeholders on demand management, supply, and inventory levels; develop S&OP process, promote its tools cross-functionally, ensure consensus forecasts; manage supply escalations

• Maintain knowledge of supply chain components: demand management, replenishment, inventory, promotional planning, logistics, seasonal planning

• Report regionally driven KPIs; create additional metrics to support affiliate performance. Sharing with European leadership status and sharing innovative solutions to avoid business disruptions

• Participate in product launches: forecast accuracy for launches, track sales vs. forecast for 6-12 months post launch; recommend inventory strategy shifts,

• Support all financial cycles: forecasting, budget and LRP: providing in-depth analysis of the demand plan

• Build and maintain effective cross-functional relationships with business leaders, Global Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Regulatory, Quality, Finance and Commercial

• English, and local language skills fluent

• Understanding of SAP and other Supply Chain systems/tools, especially around Demand and Replenishment processes

• Knowledge of Supply Chain concepts, tools and business processes and predictive analytics

• Degree in Supply Chain Management (alternatively, CPIM certified or in progress) or applicable experience

• 3+ year’s experience in the Pharmaceutical, Veterinary or Consumer Goods industry

• Strong business/financial acumen and analytical/problem-solving skills

• Strong communicator; ability to influence broadly

• Certified Operational Excellence AGILE Leader, green Belt certificate or equivalent trainings minimum required

Please note:

As this role carries global responsibilities and can be based across Europe, it is published in several countries. You only need to submit one application — there is no need to apply separately to each posting.
